name: Stain Interstage — Trim (SF)
intent: Between-coat interstage for stain/sealer/clear apply on SF substrates (wainscot, wood wall, wood ceiling). Parallel to MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM_STAIN_LF.
doctrine: SF parallel to MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM_STAIN_LF. modifier_eligibility.overhead:true lets the engine apply TRADE_OVERHEAD on wood ceiling work (per-task surface_orientation derived from ps_key — wainscot/wood_wall ps_keys don't match CEILING regex, only wood_ceiling does, so the modifier is correctly conditional).
